title: Native chromatin immunoprecipitation of histone marks to Identify enhancer status
protocol: Harvest approximately 10M cells and pellet at 500g for 3 minutes at 4°C.
Wash the cell pellet twice in 1000 μl of ice cold PBS, centrifuging at 500g for 3 minutes at 4°C after each wash.
Resuspend cells in 1000 μl ice cold NBA Buffer.
Add 1000 μl of NBB Buffer to the resuspended cells and incubate for 3 minutes on ice.
Centrifuge the mixture for 3 minutes at 1000g, 4°C.
Resuspend nuclei in 1000 μl NBR buffer and centrifuge for 3 minutes at 2000g, 4°C.
Resuspend nuclear pellet in 600 μl of NBR* (theoretically 100ng/μl).
Add 10 μl RNaseA (10 mg/ml) to the 600 μl suspension and leave for 5 minutes on the bench.
Add 40U MNase (Sigma, Boehringer units; 4U for 1M cells) to the mixture and mix by pipetting.
Incubate the mixture for 10 minutes at 20°C in a control temperature block.
Mix the solution again by pipetting after 5 minutes.
Stop by adding 600 μl STOP Buffer.
Incubate overnight on ice after adding appropriate volume of 1:1 NBR:STOP buffer to reach the final volume needed for the number of IPs.
Spin down the chromatin at 12000 g for 10 minutes.
Take 20 μL of supernatant and transfer to a new tube.
Add 1 μL of Proteinase K (20 mg/ml) and incubate for 2 hours.
Purify DNA using Qiagen MinElute PCR purification kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Elute the DNA in 10 μL.
Load the purified DNA on a 1.5% agarose gel with a DNA marker (100 – 1000 bp range).
Collect enough ProteinA beads (Dynabeads; Invitrogen) for 10ul bed volume (20ul slurry) per IP.
Prewash the beads twice in 400 μL block solution (supplemented with PMSF).
Transfer 5 μL of washed beads to separate tubes (1 per IP).
Add 5 μg of antibody to each tube, including IgG from the same species as a negative control.
Incubate for 2 hours on a rotating wheel at 4°C.
Wash antibody-bound beads once in 1000 μL blocking solution (supplemented with PMSF).
Centrifuge chromatin for 5 minutes at maximum speed at 4°C.
Transfer supernatant containing released chromatin to a new tube on ice.
Reserve 10% of the chromatin as input and freeze it at -20°C.
Add chromatin (minimum 200 μl) to antibody-bound ProteinA or G beads.
Incubate for 3-4 hours on a rotating wheel at 4°C.
Wash with ChIP-W1 buffer supplemented with inhibitors, DTT, and PMSF three times.
Rotate each wash for 10 minutes at 4°C, then pulse spin down in microcentrifuge.
Place tube in magnetic rack for 1 minute at 4°C and remove supernatant.
Wash with 1x TE at room temperature without rotating.
Remove the wash solution as above.
Resuspend beads in 1x TE and transfer to a fresh tube.
Remove TE.
Add 100 μl of elution solution heated to 37°C to the washed beads.
Vortex briefly and incubate for 15 minutes on a vibrating platform at 37°C.
Adjust pH of elutions by adding 7 μl of 2M TrisHCl pH 6.8.
Add 20 μg of proteinase K and incubate overnight at 55°C.
Add 20 μg of proteinase K to the 10% input sample.
Incubate the mixture overnight at 55°C.
Remove dynabeads for the IPs using a magnetic rack.
Purify inputs and IPs using Qiagen PCR purification columns according to manufacturer’s protocol.
Add 5x IP/Input volume of PB to IPs and Inputs and apply up to 650 μl to each purification column, centrifuge at max speed for 1 minute.
Discard flow through; add any remaining DNA and repeat procedure above.
Wash once with 600 μl Buffer PE.
After the wash, remove the flow-through and residual wash buffer from the blue rim surrounding the filter using a pipette or careful aspiration.
Centrifuge the column assembly for 1 minute in a fresh tube.
Transfer columns to new labelled tubes and elute with 10 ul of Ambion water. Leave for 1 minute; centrifuge for 1 minute at max speed.
Repeat procedure above with an additional 10 ul of milliQ water.
Quantify the DNA accurately using Qubit quantification.
Use 0.5-1 μl of sample for quantitative real-time PCR.
Generate a serial dilution from the input to calculate a standard curve, typically including no dilution / 1/3rd / 1/9th concentrations.
Mix 1 μl of DNA with 5 μl of primers (F/R, 1 mM).
Add 10 μl of Sybr Green Mix (2x).
Pipette water to make the total volume up to 20 μl.
